name: Cradle Deceleration System
description: The receiving system that made human-rated mass driver transit possible. A Cradle combines three technologies to decelerate a transit pod from Mach 2 to zero in under 6 seconds without killing the occupants: ceramic composite atmospheric braking wings that bleed off 70% of kinetic energy during descent, a 1.8-kilometer electromagnetic deceleration tube for terminal braking, and an adaptive magnetic catch funnel that corrects trajectory deviations up to 200 meters — grabbing the pod from the general vicinity and guiding it home. The Cradle's forgiveness margin is what makes the system safe. A railgun requires precision. The Cradle provides mercy. 1,203 Cradles are deployed worldwide, deliberately outnumbering accelerators for redundancy.
tier_availability: Infrastructure — not individually purchased. Built and operated by Ferrogate Transit and licensed regional operators.
developers: Arcturus Defense Solutions (adaptive magnetic field guidance — adapted from missile defense technology)
enables: mass driver passenger transit (impossible without the Cradle)
redundant receiving capacity at all major destinations
social_impact: The Cradle is the technology that turned a weapon into transit. Before Ferrogate solved the deceleration problem, mass drivers could only launch — they couldn't land anything alive. The name 'Cradle' was marketing genius: nobody wants to ride into a 'Terminal Deceleration Array.' Everyone trusts a Cradle.
story_hooks: A Cradle's adaptive catch system malfunctions during a high-profile arrival — the pod is incoming at Mach 2 and the backup Cradle is 40 seconds away
Someone reprograms a Cradle to reject a specific pod's magnetic signature — turning a landing into a missile
related_entities: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Mass Driver Turret MDT-6 'Trebuchet'
